initial_receipt.explanation: The two-job execution contains a provenance handoff fault. Job 2 received valid need record_ids n06-r01 through n06-r08, but the evidence_sources handoff has record_id values s01 through s08. The captured upstream assemble_provenance source explains this: it builds evidence rows with record_id set to record.get('source_id') instead of the original demand record_id. As a result, downstream prioritize cannot match evidence ranks to coverage record_ids and all observed upstream_rank values are 0.
